code: sign(P, A, B) = (B.x - A.x) * (P.y - A.y) - (B.y - A.y) * (P.x - A.x)

def area(x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3):
    return abs(x1*(y2 - y3) + x2*(y3 - y1) + x3*(y1 - y2)) / 2.0

def is_inside(x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3, px, py):
    A = area(x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3)
    A1 = area(px, py, x2, y2, x3, y3)
    A2 = area(x1, y1, px, py, x3, y3)
    A3 = area(x1, y1, x2, y2, px, py)
    # Allow small floating point tolerance
    return abs(A - (A1 + A2 + A3)) < 1e-9

def main():
    data = list(map(int, input().strip().split()))
    # Triangle vertices
    x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3 = data[:6]
    # Two characters
    xa, ya, xb, yb = data[6:]

    inside_a = is_inside(x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3, xa, ya)
    inside_b = is_inside(x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3, xb, yb)

    if inside_a != inside_b:
        print("OK")
    else:
        print("NG")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
